build_gtn_python_package: build the gtn python package with cmake for automatic differentiation with WFSTs
build_gtn_cmake_extensions: build the gtn cmake extensions including graph, autograd, utils, rand, creations, functions, and parallel modules
review_CMakeBuild_class: review the CMakeBuild class that validates cmake version and configures the build with debug or release mode
review_CMakeExtension_class: review the CMakeExtension class that extends setuptools Extension for cmake-based native library builds
test_gtn_setup: test the gtn setup.py to verify cmake 3.5.1 is available and all seven extensions build correctly
